## Amber Lee

Platform / Infrastructure Engineer

Amber worked at Devstack for about three years as a Cloud & AI Platform Engineer, building and operating platforms based on Kubernetes, Kubeflow, and OpenStack. Across services actually delivered to end users, she worked through multiple layers of the platform — backend development, authentication integration, GPU workload operations, cloud resource management, billing, monitoring, and troubleshooting. More recently, she has been extending her infrastructure operations experience into AIOps by connecting it with a LangGraph-based LLM Agent.

She is now pursuing an MSc in Data Science at the University of Bath (from September 2026).
